svg.font-family: "Segoe UI","Helvetica Neue","Liberation Sans",Arial,sans-serif,"Hiragino Sans","Noto Sans JP","Yu Gothic","Meiryo","IPAPGothic",sans-serif
svg.title: Distribution of 160 small-planet radii: kernel density on a log scale with a rug of every planet
svg.desc: Two peaks, at 1.3 and 2.4 Earth radii, separated by a valley at 1.7. Only 13 of 160 planets fall between 1.6 and 2 Earth radii. Density estimated on log10(radius), Gaussian kernel, bandwidth 0.047 dex.
svg.text: Curve: Gaussian kernel density of log10(radius), bandwidth 0.047 dex (Silverman), area = 1
